name: 74008 · Bixby, OK
findings: ZIP 74008 (Bixby) has 86 nonprofit organizations. 30 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 21 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 74008 (Bixby) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
37% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
